quarterly_data.signal: Sinopack H1 2026 R&D investment RMB 200,075,315.78, up 22.36%.

Sinopack (half-year report): on 04-29-2026 the board approved a new raised-fund project, a high-precision electronic ceramic production line expansion with total investment RMB 33,200.00 ten-thousand (RMB 15,190.33 ten-thousand from raised funds), planned to reach intended use in May 2029; it is 6% complete at mid-2026. The existing electronic ceramic housing production line project reached 85% progress (RMB 806,838,202.13 invested cumulatively). The GaN microwave product precision manufacturing line was cut to total investment RMB 18,985.10 ten-thousand (from RMB 55,380.78 ten-thousand) and the communication power amplifier and microwave IC R&D center to RMB 13,402.60 ten-thousand (from RMB 22,718.40 ten-thousand), both due by October 2027; the third-generation semiconductor process and packaging / test platform was delayed to October 2027, and the SiC high-voltage power module R&D project is due by 2028-10-31. Construction in progress was RMB 492,749,981.53 at mid-year.
quarterly_data.figure: ceramic line expansion RMB 33,200.00 ten-thousand, due May 2029; housing line 85% complete
